title: hassan aaye roushan hui hai fizaae
body:
hassan aaye roushan hui hai fizaae
hai har simt salle ala ki sadaae
<<DIVIDER>>
hue aaj paida hassan aye mohibbo
chalo ham masarrat ki mehfil sajaae
<<DIVIDER>>
saji hai hassan ki sana ki jo mehfil
ali qush hai deti hai zahra duaae
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke gharaane ki pehli khushi hai
hai eide hassan aao qushiyaa manaae
<<DIVIDER>>
chalo tehniyat pesh karne ali ko
imaame hassan ka qaseeda sunaae
<<DIVIDER>>
chida tazkera sibte payambar ka ju hi
to chalne lagi thandi thandi hawaae
<<DIVIDER>>
falak par farishte yahi keh rahe hai
chalo jaane hyder ka jhula jhulaae
<<DIVIDER>>
jo aaye hai bazme sanaae hassan me
unhe milgayi fatima ki duaae
<<DIVIDER>>
padhe jab bhi mushkil to dil se yaqeen se
kaho ya hassan door hogi balaae
<<DIVIDER>>
bas itni guzarish hai aye jaane zahra
karam kijiye baqsh deeje qataae
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap hai yahi aur yahi hai tamanna
hame jald aaqa madina bulaae
